title: Notations
body_md: We denote scalar values as   $\lambda$, vectors with bold letters as $\bm{\lambda}$, matrices with bold capital letters as $\mathbf{\Lambda}$ and random variables and random vector with the tilde notation as $\tilde{\xi}$ and $\tilde{\bm{\xi}}$. We use $[n]$ to denote the set $\{1, \ldots, n\}$ and $\binom{[n]}{2}$ to denote the set $\{(1,2),(1,3),\ldots,(n-1,n)\}$ of size $\binom{n}{2}$. We use $\mathbf{1}$ to denote a vector of all ones. $\mathbb{R}_n$ denotes the set of $n$ dimensional real vectors while $\mathbb{R}_n^+$ denotes the set of nonnegative vectors of size $n$. $\mathbf{A} \succeq 0$ denotes a positive semidefinite matrix $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{A} \geq 0$ denotes a nonnegative matrix $\mathbf{A}$. The trace of a matrix $\mathbf{A}$ is denoted as $trace(\mathbf{A})$. The inner product  between two matrices of the same dimension is denoted as $\mathbf{A}\bullet\mathbf{\Lambda}=trace(\mathbf{A}^T\mathbf{\Lambda})$. The diagonal entries of a square matrix $\mathbf{A}$ are denoted by $\mbox{diag}(\mathbf{A})$. $\mathbb{R}_{n\times n}^+$ is the set of $n\times n$ nonnegative matrices, and $\mathbb{S}_n$ is the set of $n\times n$ symmetric matrices. $\mathbb{I}(\text{E})$ is an indicator function that takes the value 1 when the event E occurs, 0 otherwise.
